Definition: probably contracted from Κλεόπατρος (compound of G2811 and G3962); Cleopas, a Christian:--Cleopas.
BiblicalUsage: Cleopas is a Christian, one of the two on the road to Emmaus. Luke 24:18 has him answering the stranger: art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Cleopas asks the great question of Easter without knowing it: he asks the stranger if he knows what happened, and the stranger is the one it happened to.
